result.title: Deep Auxiliary Learning via Bilevel Feature Optimization for Label-Efficient Medical Image Segmentation
result.summary: Auxiliary learning (AL), which can improve the performance of a primary task by leveraging related auxiliary tasks, is commonly regarded as a special case of multi-task learning. Existing AL approaches typically require manually annotated auxiliary labels, increasing annotation costs, particularly in medical imaging where expert labeling is expensive. In this work, we investigate whether segmentation performance can be improved using auxiliary tasks whose labels are automatically derived from existing segmentation annotations, requiring no additional manual labeling. To address this, we propose a novel auxiliary learning framework, formulated as a bilevel optimization problem. Our method enables effective knowledge transfer between tasks via a feature communication module, enhancing the primary segmentation task. We evaluate the method on three medical image segmentation benchmarks under limited-label settings. The results demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods, achieving superior label efficiency. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/FupingWu90/ALBO.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究医学图像分割中的辅助学习，把辅助任务的设计与加权表述为双层优化问题，并借助特征通信模块在主分割任务与由现有标注自动派生的辅助任务之间迁移知识，在三个基准的低标签设置下验证标签效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用双层优化自适应学习辅助任务/损失权重、并以特征通信共享表征的思路，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中多步监督的贡献分配与权重学习提供训练侧线索，但原文不涉及视觉推理的 latent 状态生成，需较多核查。
